rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep and write a narrow, administrable opinion limited to full vacatur and de novo resentencing, reflecting the conference consensus and directly answering Alito’s bright-line concern. Alito is very likely to write a lone dissent pressing the historical-fact reading of “has been imposed,” while one or two majority Justices (especially Barrett/Thomas/Gorsuch) may add short concurrences to emphasize the vacatur-as-nullity backdrop or textual framing.
